data.name: MNOZ - My Nuclear Octopus 2
data.detailed_description:
Everyone's favourite nuclear octopus is back to save the world again...

If you love old style, pure of heart out-and-out arcade gaming, you and MNOZ may just be on the verge of a beautiful friendship. It's LOUD, it's FLASHY, it's FAST, it's PSYCHEDELIC and it's a massive bag of FUN!!

This sequel to the hit OUYA game My Nuclear Octopus adds a whole new dimension to the 1% dimension, as we go full 3d! No longer big chunky old pixelly sprites, it's big chunky 3d models instead. MNO got an upgrade.

NOTE: Due to a lot of flashing lights, this game is NOT recommended for folks with any photosensitive medical conditions.

Play for a few minutes, get as far as you can, the game ends. Next time, try to beat your score. Somewhere along the way, the rest of the world disappears and you find yourself one with the Octopus, in some kind of harmony with the game as, for a short time at least, 100% of your focus goes into keeping back the marauders from the 1% dimension.

Lose yourself for a short time, just like we did in the old days. Only in the future.

Keyboard controls:

-Use A and D to choose firing direction left or right.

-UP and DOWN arrow keys move.. yep, up and down.

-Press SPACE to activate multi coloured explodipus. You get one *per level*.

Xbox controller controls:

-Hold right stick left or right to fire.

-Left stick up or down to move up or down.

-Press X,Y,B or A to activate multicoloured explodipus. You get one of these smart bombs per level.

data.short_description: Everyone's favourite nuclear octopus is back to save the world once again, in MNOZ, the explosive sequel to the hit game My Nuclear Octopus. MNOZ is a psychedelic retro arcade game for fans of pure out-and-out arcade blasters - an overload of sight and sound. Chase those high scores!
